title: Use lambdas and operator sections
description: You can pass a short function directly where another function expects it. An operator section fixes one operand of an operator.

steps.description: The lambda binds x and returns x squared. The expression applies it to 5.
The multiplication sections fix an operand at 2. Both forms multiply the supplied argument by 2.
The subtraction examples distinguish 2 minus the argument from the argument minus 2.
map receives a multiplication section. filter receives a comparison section that tests whether an element exceeds 3.
